learnings: `__init__` should leave the object in a valid state or raise.
Class attributes are shared; instance attributes belong to one object.
`__eq__` and `__hash__` must agree when objects go into sets or dict keys.
pitfalls: Updating a class counter through `self.counter += 1` would create an instance attribute – use the class name.
